title: FT-0181 blocked post-readout context receipt reroute gate with no real readout
owner_action: Record owner returns to the minimized owner packet request; no service, public, schema, lifecycle, or closeout change is allowed.
allowed_actions_before_next_review: Rehearse the owner packet workbench, decision board, change ticket, live-window card, and readout without adding users or collecting real learner traces.
Prepare the next owner ask as a minimized SRC2+ packet for one service, one owner path, one short date range, and one source system.
prohibited_actions_before_next_review: No new users, cohorts, date ranges, source systems, tool permissions, memory, public outcome claims, lifecycle promotion, schema fields, or closure review.
No raw learner traces, protected-route facts, small cells, raw security payloads, vendor-authored outcome summaries, or stronger public language.

next_evidence_ask.owner_route: Teacher-of-record plus record owner, with protected/support facts kept local and security payloads abstracted.
next_evidence_ask.date_range: One short future window only after a real owner packet exists; no backfill expansion from this rehearsal.
next_evidence_ask.packet_ceiling: Aggregate/de-identified SRC2+ packet only; no raw learner work or transcripts.
next_evidence_ask.decision_question: Can the capped reminder workflow run as a bounded, reversible first window without unauthorized-send/write behavior, fallback failure, hidden workload, suppressed-cell leakage, or public claim expansion?
next_evidence_ask.field_minimization_rule: Re-ask only fields needed for authority, construct preservation, fallback, stop triggers, workload minutes, notice, and decision delta; drop fields that do not change a decision.
next_evidence_ask.fallback_if_unavailable: Use the capped assignment-reminder workflow or keep FT-0181 live with no change.

fields_to_reask: short date range and source system
public notice and non-AI route text
fields_to_drop: raw learner traces or full transcripts
raw security payloads or exploit strings
any export field that does not change the decision board, change ticket, live-window card, or readout
public_language_action: Keep example-only language frozen; no pilot outcome, learning-impact, safety, access, workload, legal/regulatory, or scale claim.
closure_boundary: This post-readout context receipt reroute gate does not close FT-0181 and does not prove learning, safety, access, workload, compliance, or service effectiveness.
